user.title: Add a mestro player
user.description: Enter the address of the player. A player image serves on port 80; a desktop run needs the port, e.g. `192.168.1.20:8787`.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address, optionally with `:port`.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pair with mestro
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found the player {name} at {host}. Pairing asks for the PIN in the next step.

pin.title: Pair with mestro
pin.description: Enter the pairing PIN of the player at {host}. It is shown on the player's Connection page.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with mestro again
reauth_confirm.description: The player {name} at {host} no longer accepts the stored pairing. Enter its current PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the player.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address, optionally followed by `:port`.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait 30 seconds and try again.
error.unsupported_player: This player does not speak a protocol version this integration supports.

abort.not_ipv4_device: The player announced no IPv4 address. mestro serves on IPv4 only.
abort.unsupported_player: This player does not speak a protocol version this integration supports.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different player than the one set up.

brightness_failed.message: The player did not accept brightness {level}: {error}
